profile.description: 2026-or-future opportunity. Mukilteo had inflatables in its 2025 children's area, including bounce houses and two obstacle courses, so Adventure Zone should be positioned as a future full staffed inflatable-carnival option rather than as a second inflatable provider operating alongside an incumbent. The current inflatable provider is not verified. Keep 2026 open only as a backup if their plans change or they still have an unmet need.

notes.subject: 2026/future inflatable-carnival opportunity - Mukilteo Lighthouse Festival
notes.body: 2026 Mukilteo Lighthouse Festival is Sept. 11-13 at Lighthouse Park, 609 Front Street, Mukilteo WA. Official festival information says normal booth applications are closed and lists info@mukfest.com / 425-353-5516. Independent 2025 festival coverage and a current local event page confirm the children's area had inflatables, including bounce houses and two obstacle courses. The supplier/provider was not verified, so do not name or speculate about a competitor. Email positioning should stay friendly and non-competitive: mention that we noticed they already offer inflatables and introduce The Adventure Zone as a full staffed inflatable carnival to consider if their plans change this year or for a future year. Because this is last-minute, keep both commercial models available without over-pushing either: prepaid means the event pays the package fee so guests enjoy the attractions free; pay-for-play can also work, with Adventure Zone charging the public to play and paying the event a percentage of ticket-box sales. Washington weather should be considered but should not automatically rule out pay-for-play.

followUps.label: Mukilteo inflatable-carnival follow-up
followUps.reason: Do not pitch Adventure Zone as an additional inflatable vendor beside an incumbent. Ask to be considered if their 2026 plans change or for a future year as a full staffed inflatable-carnival option. Keep the tone friendly and non-competitive.
